title: Thunder 3
description: Unremarkably ordinary middle schoolers, Pyontaro, Hiroshi and Tsubame, wander into an extraordinary adventure when Pyontaro’s little sister goes missing.

episodes_data.title: Thunder 3 Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Pyontaro, Hiroshi and Tsubame — the Small 3 — load up an odd disc from their teacher. When they're not looking, Pyontaro's little sister Futaba vanishes.
